mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SmnrAtndDAO.smnrAtndeSelect 설 명 : 세미나참석자조회 */ SELECT NVL((SELECT DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID),'-') AS DEPTNM , NVL(USR.STDNT_NO,'-') AS STDNT_NO , USR.USERNM , USR.USER_ID , ATND.SMNR_ATND_ID , ATND.ATND_MEMO , NVL(ATND.ATND_EVL_SCR, 0) AS ATND_EVL_SCR FROM TB_LMS_USER USR LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMNR_ATND ATND ON USR.USER_ID = ATND.ATNDE_ID AND ATND.SMNR_ID = #{smnrId} WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId}
